comment: Cheap source-directed variation of the C79 clairvoyance spell route: Samurai starts with P_DIVINATION_SPELL at Basic in u_init.c:Skill_S, below P_SKILLED, so spell.c leaves the pseudo spellbook unblessed and do_vicinity_map uses non-extended detection unless Clairvoyant is already active. The source menu order is unchanged (SPE_CLAIRVOYANCE offset 19 => t). New seed/date and Samurai role exercise the basic-skill branch without changing the caller. Escape closes any getpos browse opened by the spell.
